_README: Named SUBJECTS a headless lane can be pointed at, consumed by ops/loop/scope.py.
Point a lane at one for a single run with CLOCKSPEED_LANE_SCOPE_<LANE>=<name>;
for the queue lane that is CLOCKSPEED_LANE_SCOPE_QUEUE=dashboard.
THIS FILE IS A HAND-MAINTAINED ID LIST AND THAT IS ONLY SAFE BECAUSE IT IS
VALIDATED ON EVERY READ. ops/loop/scope.py::validate_scope grades every member
against the live ROADMAP.md item lines, docs/GATED.md and docs/LEDGER.md, and
refuses LOUDLY naming the offender when a member has closed, is gated, is a
phase gate row, or is absent. A scope that finds nothing and a scope that is
wrong are different events here and never render the same.
WHEN A MEMBER CLOSES, DELETE ITS ID FROM THE items LIST. That is the whole
maintenance burden, and tests/ops/test_lane_scope.py goes RED until it is done.
DO NOT add a member without checking it is an open ROADMAP.md row. Do not add a
phase gate row (they are rejected anyway - CLAUDE.md and tools/headless-queue.md
section 5 FENCE 1 both forbid taking one) and do not add a docs/GATED.md id.

dashboard.description: The dashboard and companion surface rows. NOT expressible as a phase filter: seven sit under '## Phase 6 - surfaces' and CS-962, the row that says the dashboard renders nothing a player would act on, sits in the phase 4 block entirely.
